soundness_flags.label: Theorem 2: exact algebraic certification
soundness_flags.one_line: The theorem quantifies over every rational p but promises endpoints and an attaining SCM even when the refinement fiber is empty; require a nonempty fiber premise or specify an infeasibility certificate as the alternative output.

soundness_flags.label: def:order-only-model and Theorem 4
soundness_flags.one_line: An arbitrary mass on complete response signatures is not generally realizable on each declared D with its stated bidirected structure: a common latent realizing arbitrary rho induces additional bidirected dependence, while factorized edge latents would constrain rho; define the comparator directly as the temporal-order complete-SCM class or impose the compatible factorization.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Proceedings bibliographic record and abstract; theorem text corroborated in arXiv:2410.23975v2, pp. 5 and 9-10
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper gives sufficient SCG conditions for controlled micro-direct-effect identification with hidden confounding, and its arXiv theorem gives the conditional-mean adjustment formula when the outcome SCC is contained in the singleton and no bidirected edge joins the outcome to an ancestor.

The article establishes finite canonicalization for discrete canonical DAGs, polynomializes causal queries, and shows Algorithm 2 yields a polynomial program whose extrema are sharp; its practical algorithm uses numerical epsilon-sharp bounds.
The preprint turns a query-implied causal order into a tight LP and proves its unrestricted response-signature quotient preserves the LP extrema by aggregating and uniformly lifting simplex masses.

The paper studies constraint-aware canonical-domain reduction by quotienting states indistinguishable to the LP objective and constraints, with preservation of feasibility and sharp bounds for the induced unrestricted simplex program.
The paper proves that a constant-size segment, bounded by width and maximal direct or latent lag, suffices for causal-identification decisions in a known time-series graph.
The paper provides analytically computable causal-effect bounds from a PAG representing a Markov-equivalence class.
The paper constructs minimum-average-volume confidence regions for a multinomial parameter and derives confidence intervals for linear functionals.
EasyRCA uses adjustment-based direct effects in acyclic summary causal graphs and its root-cause claim combines the stated propositions under its assumptions.
This is the published quantifier-elimination complexity source cited for the exact real-algebraic layer; it does not itself provide a temporal causal compiler or SCM decoder.
The paper applies real quantifier elimination to small hidden-variable graphical-model problems, including identification and bounds questions.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Replace the D-indexed order-only construction by one explicit temporal-order complete-SCM response-signature model, or else impose the exact latent-factorization constraint for each D; then restate and replay all four endpoint certificates against that repaired comparator.
Add nonempty refinement-fiber compatibility to Theorem 2 and make Cert return an exact infeasibility certificate when compatibility fails.

After the six-vertex quotient kill test, promote the outcome into a general latent-incidence criterion with a proved quotient-size bound; a positive criterion would turn the open computational component into a stronger independent result.

recommended_next_step: Revise the two well-posedness defects, rerun the rational endpoint certificate against the repaired order-only comparator, then advance the field-tier sharp-envelope kernel to Stage 0.
